fixtureMode.label: FIXTURE MODE · synthetic local data
fixtureMode.description: A loopback-only backend, virtual WebAuthn authenticator, fake wallet material, and masked local credentials replace Vault, Stripe, cloud, and physical-authenticator dependencies.

flows.title: Actual unpacked extension demo
flows.description: Loads the real Manifest V3 extension in a persistent Chromium profile, configures it with fake loopback settings, and drives the real Wallet Standard demo through virtual WebAuthn.

steps.title: Configure the trusted worker
steps.description: Point the unpacked extension at the loopback fixture. The password field contains only a fake local marker and remains visually masked.

steps.title: Discover the actual extension
steps.description: Open the bundled extension demo and wait for its Wallet Standard registration event.

steps.title: Register a fixture passkey
steps.description: Chrome's CDP virtual authenticator completes the real browser WebAuthn API while the local fixture records only public credential data.

steps.title: Authorize a message signature
steps.description: Exercise the real provider, content script, service worker, backend request shape, and WebAuthn assertion path with a deterministic fixture signature.

steps.title: Sign a legacy transaction
steps.description: Prepare a deterministic zero-lamport transaction, approve it with virtual WebAuthn, and return bytes signed by the fixture-only Solana key.

flows.title: Standalone wallet page
flows.description: Drives the real standalone acceptance page against the loopback fixture using an Ethereum EIP-191 example and virtual WebAuthn.

steps.title: Review the custody boundary
steps.description: The page explains that key material remains behind the backend boundary; fixture mode uses no real funds or secrets.

steps.title: Choose Ethereum messages
steps.description: Select the implemented Ethereum EIP-191 message path without implying Ethereum transaction support.

steps.title: Register the fixture wallet
steps.description: Complete navigator.credentials.create with the virtual authenticator and a deterministic fixture address.

steps.title: Prepare a test message
steps.description: Encode a clearly synthetic local message as the payload bound to the next ceremony.

steps.title: Approve the signature
steps.description: Complete navigator.credentials.get and display a deterministic fixture result, never a production signature.

flows.title: Developer dashboard
flows.source: built services /developer route + recording-only memory billing runtime
flows.description: Explains developer onboarding, masked API credentials, endpoint usage, and the transition from sandbox to production.

steps.title: Sign in to the real console route
steps.description: Submit a clearly fake demo account through the actual login, session-cookie, redirect, and role-check path.

steps.title: Review the integration health
steps.description: Start from seeded local billing and usage data without any external Stripe, Metronome, or cloud dependency.

steps.title: Open API key management
steps.description: Show lifecycle and scope controls while all credential values remain masked and fixture-only.

steps.title: Prepare a sandbox credential
steps.description: Fill synthetic scope metadata without submitting the form, so the recording never creates, renders, or stores an API token value.

steps.title: Inspect endpoint usage
steps.description: Review deterministic active-wallet and transaction usage against seeded plan limits without a live metering provider.

flows.title: Admin dashboard
flows.source: built services /admin route + recording-only memory billing runtime
flows.description: Walks through tenant operations, policy state, and audit review using synthetic local records.

steps.title: Sign in to the real admin route
steps.description: Submit a clearly fake administrator account through the actual login, session-cookie, redirect, and role-check path.

steps.title: Review system posture
steps.description: Begin with a deterministic status summary that is explicitly not connected to production infrastructure.

steps.title: Open the tenant directory
steps.description: Navigate synthetic tenants and their scoped wallet policies without exposing personal data.

steps.title: Inspect the seeded fixture account
steps.description: Select the clearly named Spiral Safe seeded demo account and review its synthetic policy and usage state.

steps.title: Review delivery state
steps.description: Display synthetic usage-outbox counts with no credentials, authenticator blobs, or production identifiers.
